I'm working on a Spring Boot microservices food delivery application with the following setup:

**Project Architecture:**
- Workspace Root: Food-Delivery-main
- Infrastructure Services: Config Server (8888), Eureka Server (8761), API Gateway (8080/9090)
- Business Services: User (8081), Restaurant (8082), Order (8083), Payment (8084), Notification (8085)
- E2E Tests: e2e-tests/src/test/java/com/fooddelivery/e2e/
- Config Repository: config-repo/
- Kubernetes Manifests: k8s/
- WireMock: e2e-tests
